Random but full of joy
May 2024 • Friends
Just happened to pass by this restaurant and decided to come in for a try. My first impression was that the staffs here take care of their customers really well, they even prepared birthday dishes as gifts for the reserved tables. The food here is quite wonderful and diverse, from classics to fusion dishes while still made it easy for customers to consume, definitely recommend the Beef Rossini and the Wayu Salmon . Beverages are not as diverse but didn't make it less delicious, we ordered some cocktails for the evening and I feel like the Golden Hour and Whisdream are must try. Overall my experience here is wonderful, worth the price, if you're travelling and want to try something different traditional Vietnamese food, I highly recommend you give this place a try.
